# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RSI_DIVERGENCE_VWAP_RECLAIM_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After 11:30 EST, a bearish RSI divergence coupled with failure to reclaim VWAP signals weakening momentum and a short opportunity. The divergence indicates underlying weakness despite price making higher highs, while VWAP reclaim failure shows lack of buying pressure to sustain the move.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: After 11:30, if price makes a higher high while RSI(14) makes a lower low (bearish divergence) and price fails to close above VWAP for two consecutive 5‑min bars, enter short at the close of the second bar. Exit: chart‑stop at the most recent swing high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.0R, runner trail 15% off the high‑water mark. Regime hint: only consider when VIX > 18 and the EMA ribbon is flat or slightly descending; avoid strong uptrend ribbon (steep upward EMA stack).
